name: coding-agents
description: Coding Agents state-first continuation and new-task intake for named requests or strong continuation intent on valid .coding-agents state. Primary route: inspect active state, preserve related progress, and default coding/source work to ITERATIVE_DELIVERY; ONE_SHOT_QUALITY requires explicit task-local user authority. Fallback: parent-side work when official subagents are unavailable; never launch codex exec or a custom process runner. Do not ask the user for a routine new-versus-continue mode.

interface.shortDescription: State-first continuation and new-task intake; official Codex spawn only for workers.
interface.longDescription: Select Coding Agents when named, when valid .coding-agents state accompanies strong continuation intent, or when its state or CLI is audited or repaired. Inspect task, active checklist, audit, runner, and handoff state before choosing a transition. Semantically related work preserves completed progress and appends from the first unfinished point; only clearly unrelated work gets a fresh task identity and regenerated active state. Coding/source work defaults to ITERATIVE_DELIVERY: reach a runnable primary-path release, observe real operation, and repair concrete failures quickly. ONE_SHOT_QUALITY is task-local, non-sticky, and requires explicit user authority. Historical runner packets remain readable, and actual workers are dispatched only through official Codex subagent spawn tools; the CLI never launches codex exec or a custom runner fallback.
defaultPrompt: Inspect .coding-agents state; default to ITERATIVE_DELIVERY and use ONE_SHOT_QUALITY only when I explicitly requested it.
Continue .coding-agents: preserve checked items, append related work, and use fresh intake only if clearly unrelated.
Audit or repair Coding Agents state or its source CLI; dispatch workers only through official Codex subagent spawn tools.
